summary: Bilingual first-party discovery and current viewer inspection identified Bihar's official BhuNaksha service and the Bhagalpur/Sultanganj revenue custodian. Administrative selector metadata was returned, but attempted map extent routes returned null fields or HTTP 204; no safe parcel ID or polygon was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries and requests, including URLs, payloads, statuses, schema observations, and limits, are recorded in city-11409-sultanganj.json.

custodians.name: Directorate of Land Records & Survey / Revenue and Land Reforms Department, Government of Bihar
custodians.scope: State cadastral mapping and land-record services, including BhuNaksha.
custodians.evidence: Official BhuNaksha and BiharBhumi pages plus live selector REST responses.

custodians.name: Bhagalpur District Administration
custodians.scope: Local district land-record service lead for Sultanganj.

safeFieldAllowlist: native parcel identifier if publicly returned and source-proven
registryBasis: A local district land-record page and a current official state cadastral viewer with Bhagalpur/Sultanganj administrative selectors were evidenced. This does not establish open citywide parcel geometry completeness.
coverageLimits: Only selector metadata and route behavior were verified; no parcel geometry was returned.
The exact WUP point was not shifted and no exact-point absence inference was made.
No citywide or countrywide coverage qualification was performed.
uncertainty: One selected mauza extent route returned null extent fields; another returned HTTP 204.
Direct WMS capabilities did not yield usable schema.
A later attempt may need to reproduce the interactive viewer sequence or use a populated map instance.
doNotInfer: No geometry is not evidence that Sultanganj has no parcels.
The packet is research evidence only, not source integration or admission.
